topic: Adaptation, survival, biodiversity, and carrying capacity
key_concepts: Biodiversity, stability, adaptation, and survivability are interconnected
Species diversity increases the probability of adaptation and survival in changing environ
Tropical rainforest ecosystems generally have greater biodiversity than desert ecosystems
Environmental factors affect the biodiversity of organisms in an area
Carrying capacity is the maximum number of organisms an environment can support
Each population has a different carrying capacity depending on available resources
Density-dependent limiting factors are influenced by population density
Density-independent limiting factors are not directly influenced by population density
Population growth can be logistic or exponential
Population growth is related to carrying capacity
